description: This file defines a 'DestinationList' component utilizing LightningJS's Blits framework, rendering a scrollable list of destination cards with a custom scrollbar and related logic.

classes.name: DestinationList
classes.description: A LightningJS component displaying a scrollable list of destination cards with scrollbar, handling scrolling logic and rendering.

methods.name: calcX
methods.description: Calculates the x-position for a destination card based on its index, supporting grid layout.

methods.name: calcY
methods.description: Calculates the y-position for a destination card based on its index to support vertical layout.

methods.name: updateThumb
methods.description: Updates scrollbar thumb size and position based on current scroll offset and total items.

methods.name: $onSelect
methods.description: Handles destination selection, logging selected item's title.
